Your previous life, you were the brightest, shining star. Your ability to turn lies into truths… Perhaps it’s the other way around? Whatever it may be, your eyes shine brilliantly in response to being on the biggest stage.

Passive
[Passive, True] Fever Pitch - After using Performance, switch to the Truth mode, and vice versa.
Active
[Active, Held] Performance - Charm all non-allied entities in your presence in a 20 block radius, costing 250 MP/s to use. This Charm will wear off after 30 seconds and cannot be re-applied. Upon completing your performance, [Fever Pitch] activates. Addtionally, go on a 60 second cooldown. (I think the charm on this mode is bugged atm but do let me know)
All entities allied to you will gain Inspiration instead.
The maximum time you can Perform for is 15 seconds.
Active: [Active, Press, Lie Mode] Masquerade - Tell a lie so grand it could become a truth. Hide the pain behind a dazzling smile that blinds the audience! Restore 25% HP and SHP of all allied entities in a 20 block radius and grant a slight speed buff to allies as well.
Active: [Active, Press, Truth Mode] Unveil - Reveal the darkness, pain and sadness in your heart, paralyzing non-allied entities in a 10 block radius in fear for 10 seconds. On mastery, additionally grants Marked For Death for the same duration. Cooldown of 30 seconds and costs 500 MP to use.
Active: [Mastery, Active, Press] Star Power - The six pointed star awakens. Grant all non-allied entities looking at you the Dazzled effect, freezing them in place for 10 seconds, making them unable to look away! Cooldown of 40 seconds.
No English wiki description is available for this skill.

Have a body made of magisteel, making it much harder and gaining progressively stronger armor depending on your EP.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Magisteel Body:
Click here to show armor levels
Every milestone in the user's EP will net them an increase in armor. The resulting armor points is rounded DOWN. Keep in mind that all of these armor points stack with normal armor.
At 25,000 EP and lower, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Low Magisteel. This totals 20 armor points.
At 50,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of High Magisteel. This totals 24 armor points.
At 80,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Pure Magisteel. This totals 40 armor points.
At 550,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Adamantite. This totals 48 armor points.
And at 1,000,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set Hihi'irokane. This totals 56 armor points.
Notes
To use this skill, you need to be either the Greater Doll Line or a spiritual being possessing a magisteel golem

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Hindrance Removal - When activating this passive, instantly be cleared of any movement-hindering effects. This includes Burden and Slowness.
While toggled, those effects cannot be applied to you.
Active
[Active, Press] Fixation - Using this skill mode will aim to target an entity 5 blocks ahead of you (10 blocks on mastery).
When missing, this mode goes on a 5 second cooldown.
If you successfully target an entity, Fixate that entity in place, making it impossible for them to move or attack. Your target cannot utilize skills while fixated. They also cannot turn their mouse. This lasts for 15 seconds. When the effect wears off, it cannot be re-applied for one minute.
Active: [Active, Press] Solidification - Solidify the air molecules in front of you, creating an invisible shield three blocks in front. You cannot walk through this shield, but it blocks all damage and projectiles from passing through it.
Crouch and activate to remove it. Cooldown of 10 seconds.
Active: [Art, Press] Eternal Domain - At the user’s location, instantly create a Fixation field around you. When inside this field, gain the Stasis effect, setting all your magicule costs to ZERO while you are within the field. The field is 8 blocks big, doubling to 16 on mastery.
Any targets caught WITHIN the radius of Eternal Domain are FIXATED while the domain exists.
Cooldown of 180 seconds. On mastery, this reduces to 90 seconds.
